purpose: Machine-readable starter workflows for public educational biomedical research, not executable agent actions or endorsements
privacy: Public sources only; do not send patient records, PII, confidential manuscripts, private keys or credentials
rules: Retrieve and verify official source content before asserting an observation
Do not invent retrievals, models, datasets or experimental results
Separate original experiment, interpretation, hypothesis, modern teaching analogy, and clinical evidence
Preserve paper DOI/URL, study type, source location, dataset accession/version and review date
Do not infer clinical utility, diagnosis or treatment from database associations or simulations
Treat author/editorial approval as review status, not journal peer review

workflows.label: Select public research tools
steps: Fetch current catalog JSON and examine record IDs, official_url, access and limitations
Recommend at most 3 source-backed tools and a beginner-sized first action
Cite original provider URLs and disclose retrieval limits
workflows.output: record_id and why-fit table, first task, limitations and source check

workflows.label: Source-level evidence checking
steps: Locate original study and precise methods, results, figure or table for the claim
Classify observation vs interpretation vs hypothesis and clinical setting
workflows.output: source-located claim evidence matrix and uncertainty

workflows.label: Interactive science tutoring
steps: Ask a prediction before revealing the original result
Confirm what was tested and what remains unresolved
Guide a safe verification task using the cited public research tool
workflows.output: learner evidence trail with original and modern-tool dates

workflows.label: Reproduce public analysis
steps: Verify the dataset and method are publicly reusable
List software versions, scripts, controls, transformations and expected metrics
Propose reproducibility checks; label missing files as blocked
workflows.output: reproducible workflow proposal, gaps and validation checklist
